questions.explanation: The official accepted numerical range provided by IISc Bengaluru is 2.4 to 2.4.

questions.questionText:
A city with a present population of 1,75,000 is expecting an annual population
growth rate of 0.85%. In a traffic assessment study, the trip generation model has
been developed as Y = 142 + 0.675X, where Y is the number of daily trips generated
within the city and X is the population of the city. The number of daily trips to be
generated within the city after 10 years is _____________(in integer).

contentBlocks.content:
A city with a present population of 1,75,000 is expecting an annual population
growth rate of 0.85%. In a traffic assessment study, the trip generation model has
been developed as Y = 142 + 0.675X, where Y is the number of daily trips generated
within the city and X is the population of the city. The number of daily trips to be
generated within the city after 10 years is _____________(in integer).

questions.explanation: The official accepted numerical range provided by IISc Bengaluru is 128500 to 128800.
